title: Pasting a section comparison with a source isomorphism
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring. Let p:X→S, q:U→S, r:W→T admit compactifications, with q and r quasi-compact. Let h:U≅X be over S, v:T→S, and a:W→U give Cartesian squares for q and p. Suppose z:S→X, w:S→U, b:T→W satisfy w h=z and b a=v w. Then pullback along v of the identity-base section comparison induced by h, followed by the section comparison induced by a, equals the section comparison induced by a h. All comparisons are the specified maps of [def-trf-bundle-section-orientation-data]; the statement has no orientation or normalization hypothesis.

source.place: Step 4; parent orientation node proof Step 3

proof.text: Expand the section comparisons. Compact-support exchange horizontal pasting identifies the inverse exchange for the pasted Cartesian square with the two inverse exchanges, including inverse-image compositors.

Apply mateEquiv_vcomp and conjugate-equivalence identity coherence. Pullback compositor associativity pastes the section squares. Naturality and composition of constant-unit pullback cancel the identity base comparison and give the asserted component equation.

lean.statement:
theorem bundleSectionComparison_iso_pasting
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X U W S T : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) (q : U ⟶ S) (r : W ⟶ T)
    [HasCompactification p] [HasCompactification q] [HasCompactification r]
    [QuasiCompact q] [QuasiCompact r]
    (h : U ≅ X) (hp : h.hom ≫ p = q) (v : T ⟶ S) (a : W ⟶ U)
    (sq : IsPullback a r q v) (sq' : IsPullback (a ≫ h.hom) r p v)
    (z : S ⟶ X) (w : S ⟶ U) (b : T ⟶ W) (hz : w ≫ h.hom = z)
    (hw : b ≫ a = v ≫ w) (hw' : b ≫ (a ≫ h.hom) = v ≫ z) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A v).map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).inv.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A z).obj
              ((rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).obj
                (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S))) ≫
          bundleSectionComparison A p q h.hom (𝟙 S)
            (IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso
              (CommSq.mk (hp.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)))
            z w (hz.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)) ≫
        bundleSectionComparison A q r a v sq w b hw =
      bundleSectionComparison A p r (a ≫ h.hom) v sq' z b hw'
